dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What are you looking for, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ər juː ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːr, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My receipt for the jeans. I can't find it anywhere.
dialogue.reading: maɪ rɪˈsiːt fər ðə ˈdʒiːnz. aɪ ˈkænt ˈfaɪnd ɪt ˈɛniwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Where did you go yesterday? Maybe it's there.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛr dɪd juː ˈɡoʊ ˈjɛstərdeɪ? ˈmeɪbi ɪts ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nowhere. I stayed home all day.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊwɛr. aɪ ˈsteɪd ˈhoʊm ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then it's somewhere in the apartment.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ɪts ˈsʌmwɛr ɪn ði əˈpɑːrtmənt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let's look for it together. I'll search the living room.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈlʊk fər ɪt təˈɡɛðər. aɪl ˈsɜːrtʃ ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ˌruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Maybe I threw it away with the trash!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ˈmeɪbi aɪ ˈθruː ɪt əˈweɪ wɪð ðə ˈtræʃ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wait! Look! It's under the sofa.
dialogue.reading: ˈweɪt! ˈlʊk! ɪts ˈʌndər ðə ˈsoʊfə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! I looked everywhere, but not there!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! aɪ ˈlʊkt ˈɛvriwɛr, bʌt ˈnɑːt ˈðɛr!
